howItWorksPage.title: How
howItWorksPage.subtitle: From the first click to the final review — understand every step of the experience for clients and professionals.
howItWorksPage.s1Title: Search for the service you need
howItWorksPage.s1Desc: Use filters by category, location and rating to find qualified professionals near you.
howItWorksPage.s2Desc: Analyze verified profiles, portfolios with real photos and detailed reviews from other clients.
howItWorksPage.s2d2: Portfolios with photos of previous work
howItWorksPage.s2d3: Reviews with ratings and real comments
howItWorksPage.s3Desc: Use the integrated chat to discuss details, agree on prices and set deadlines before hiring.
howItWorksPage.s4Desc: Payment is held on the platform until you approve the service completion.
howItWorksPage.s5Desc: After completion, rate the professional and help other clients make good choices.
howItWorksPage.guaranteeDesc: If the service is not delivered as agreed, we refund 100% of the amount. Our mediation team is available to resolve any conflict.
howItWorksPage.faq1q: Do I need to pay to sign up?
howItWorksPage.faq1a: No. Registration is free for both clients and professionals. We only charge a small fee on completed transactions.
howItWorksPage.faq2a: The service amount is held on the platform (escrow). The professional only receives after the client approves completion. In case of issues, our mediation team intervenes.
howItWorksPage.faq3q: Can I cancel a hired service?
howItWorksPage.faq3a: Yes. Before start, cancellation is free. After start, we apply our mediation policy to ensure fairness for both parties.
howItWorksPage.faq4a: Yes. Everyone goes through identity verification. Professionals with the 'Verified' badge have completed additional validation steps.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1Text: By accessing and using the 1001JOBS platform, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you disagree, do not use the platform.
terms.s2Text: 1001JOBS is a platform that connects clients to professional service providers. We are not part of negotiations between users.
terms.s3Text: To use the platform, you must create an account with truthful information and keep it updated.
terms.s4Text: Each user is responsible for the information provided, the quality of services rendered and compliance with appointments.
terms.s5Text: All platform content, including brand, layout and code, is the property of 1001JOBS.
terms.s6Text: We reserve the right to change these terms at any time. Changes take effect after publication.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: We collect name, email, phone, location and usage data to enable the platform's operation.
privacy.s2Text: Your data is used to create your account, display profiles, facilitate appointments and send relevant notifications.
privacy.s3Text: We do not sell your data. Public profile information is visible to other users as per the platform's nature.
privacy.s4Text: We use encryption and industry-standard security practices to protect your data.
privacy.s5Text: You may request access, correction or deletion of your personal data by contacting us.
privacy.s6Text: We use essential cookies for authentication and platform operation.
